# Mohanad Games (استوديو ألعاب مهند)

> Mohanad Games is an independent mobile game development and publishing studio founded by Mohanad Najih Attieh (مهند ناجح عطية), creating original cultural trivia, real-time multiplayer, trick-puzzle, and story-driven mobile games for iOS and Android, with 30+ published titles on the Apple App Store and Google Play.

## Studio Overview
- **Studio Name:** Mohanad Games (ألعاب مهند / استوديو ألعاب مهند)
- **Founder & Lead Developer:** Mohanad Najih Attieh (مهند ناجح عطية)
- **Founder LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/mohanad-attieh
- **Official Website:** https://www.mohanadgames.com/
- **English Studio Page:** https://www.mohanadgames.com/en/
- **Business & Support Email:** info@mohanadgames.com
- **Platforms:** Apple App Store (iOS / iPadOS) & Google Play Store (Android)
- **Google Play Developer Catalog:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/dev?id=6796927971116266798
- **Apple App Store Developer Catalog:** https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/mohanad-najih-attieh/id1658812059

## Flagship & Featured Games

### 1. فطحل سوريا (Fathal Syria)
- **Genre:** Arabic Cultural Trivia, Visual Memory & Real-Time Multiplayer
- **Summary:** Fast-reflex trivia game celebrating Syrian television drama history, iconic series scenes, actors, and Levantine proverbs, featuring daily tournaments, live multiplayer rooms, and leaderboards.
- **Official Page:** https://www.mohanadgames.com/games/fathal-syria/
- **Google Play:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fathalsyria.app
- **App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/us/app/%D9%81%D8%B7%D8%AD%D9%84-%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7/id6797496747

### 2. Think More Think Less
- **Genre:** Trick & Lateral-Thinking Logic Puzzles
- **Summary:** Hand-crafted trick-puzzle game where every level is a compact interactive scene with a clever twist hiding in plain sight. Players drag, tap, and experiment beyond the obvious move.
- **Google Play:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.thinkmore.thinkless.game
- **App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/us/app/think-more-think-less/id6824479228

### 3. يوميات ريان (Rayan's Diary)
- **Genre:** Casual Comedy & Puzzle Adventure
- **Summary:** Story-driven puzzle adventure following a lovable procrastinator named Rayan through humorous everyday dilemmas with unexpected solutions.
- **App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/us/app/%D9%8A%D9%88%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%86/id6754023958

### 4. قصة حب شاكر (Shakr Love Story)
- **Genre:** Narrative Romance & Brainteasers
- **Summary:** Story-and-puzzle journey following Shakr and Tala across Arab and global cities, solving situational challenges in each chapter.
- **App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/us/app/shakr-love-story/id6759489066

### 5. Additional Published Titles
- **تحدي المسلسلات (Series Challenge):** Arabic word and crossword puzzles inspired by Syrian and Arab television drama.
- **حزورات مهند — ألغاز وإيموجي (Al-Hazzazir):** Emoji riddles, proverbs, and lateral-thinking Arabic word puzzles.
- **التحدي الأزرق / التحدي الرياضي / الفهيم العربي / كلمات متقاطعة:** Specialized Arabic crossword, sports trivia, and multiplayer word-discovery games.
